# China AI Hub Data Hub

> Structured data layer for china-ai-hub.pages.dev: machine-readable entity records for Chinese AI models, agents, companies, APIs, pricing and benchmarks. Each page carries JSON-LD anchored to the canonical main-site entity.

## Core pages
- [Home](https://china-ai-hub-data.pages.dev/): Data Hub overview.
- [Models index](https://china-ai-hub-data.pages.dev/models/): List of models entity records with canonical main-site links.
- [Companies index](https://china-ai-hub-data.pages.dev/companies/): List of companies entity records with canonical main-site links.
- [Agents index](https://china-ai-hub-data.pages.dev/agents/): List of agents entity records with canonical main-site links.
- [Apis index](https://china-ai-hub-data.pages.dev/apis/): List of apis entity records with canonical main-site links.
- [Pricing index](https://china-ai-hub-data.pages.dev/pricing/): List of pricing entity records with canonical main-site links.
- [Benchmarks index](https://china-ai-hub-data.pages.dev/benchmarks/): List of benchmarks entity records with canonical main-site links.

## Machine-readable data (JSON)
- [Models JSON](https://china-ai-hub.pages.dev/data/models.json): All model records with verified fields.
- [Companies JSON](https://china-ai-hub.pages.dev/data/companies.json): All company records.
- [Agents JSON](https://china-ai-hub.pages.dev/data/agents.json): All agent records.
- [APIs JSON](https://china-ai-hub.pages.dev/data/apis.json): All API records.
- [Pricing JSON](https://china-ai-hub.pages.dev/data/pricing.json): Normalized pricing snapshots with effective dates.
- [Benchmarks JSON](https://china-ai-hub.pages.dev/data/benchmarks.json): All benchmark results with source types.
- Per-model JSON: https://china-ai-hub.pages.dev/models/{model-id}.json — entity record plus related benchmarks and agents.
